verdicts.reason: In A the hierarchy is inverted: the legal disclaimer is set nearly as large as the headline and takes up the whole right side. SOLSTICE has been moved below the headline, the CTA is jammed against the left edge with a tiny pill under it, the pills are cut off and out of order, and the top-left text is illegible. B keeps a sensible left-to-right reading order (SOLSTICE, then the headline, then the CTA on the right) and the brand colours, but the subtitle and legal text are microscopic fragments squeezed in beside the pills. The pills are also reordered and cramped against the bottom edge.
